faqs.question: What is the shelf life of Liquid Spawn Broth?
faqs.answer: When stored in refrigeration between 2°C to 4°C, our liquid spawn broth maintains peak viability for up to 90 days.

faqs.question: How is contamination prevented during shipping?
faqs.answer: All containers use biosecure 0.2-micron breathable membrane filters and temperature-monitored cold chain packaging.

faqs.question: Do you provide strain documentation?
faqs.answer: Yes, every batch is accompanied by a Certificate of Analysis (COA) specifying genomic strain ID, purity index, and autoclave logs.
